decisions.reason: Its through-contact technology remains central to advanced packaging options and uncertainty is still high, so the low cost of keeping it open justifies retention.
Carrier wafers are a low-cost, established option aligned with the firm's reusable-carrier direction, so there is little reason to abandon it now.
As a flagship copper interposer option with high strategic value and unresolved market uncertainty, the firm keeps this option open.
The off-the-shelf brand is a low-uncertainty, revenue-relevant option that costs little to maintain and supports the core wafer business.
Glass-based circuit boards have shown only weak website presence and lie outside the core packaging-wafer options, suggesting the option value is unlikely to justify further keeping costs.
